name: fulldome-empty-canvas

scripts.dev:suite: concurrently -k -n broker,controls,timeline,domesrv,domecli,canvas -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow,gray "npx -y av-controls-server" "npx -y av-controller" "npx -y av-timeline" "npx -y dome-control-server" "npx -y dome-control-client" vite
